signature.name: Teatro Colon
signature.detail: One of the world's great opera houses, famous for its acoustics and gilded interior. Book a guided tour in advance, as slots sell out, and dress smartly for evening performances.

signature.name: Casa Rosada
signature.detail: The pink presidential palace facing Plaza de Mayo, home to Argentina's executive branch. Visit on a weekday for the free guided tour, and see the balcony made famous by Eva Perón.

signature.name: Recoleta Cemetery
signature.detail: An eerie, beautiful maze of mausoleums where Eva Perón rests. Go early morning to avoid crowds; entry is free and the gates are open daily.

signature.name: Plaza de Mayo
signature.detail: The historic heart of the city, ringed by the Casa Rosada and the Cabildo. Come on a Thursday afternoon to see the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo march.

signature.name: Obelisco de Buenos Aires
signature.detail: The city's iconic white obelisk on Avenida 9 de Julio, best seen at night when it is lit. It is a quick photo stop near the Teatro Colon.

signature.name: Caminito
signature.detail: The brightly painted street in La Boca, alive with tango dancers and street art. Go on a sunny weekday morning and stay on the main streets for safety.

signature.name: El Ateneo Grand Splendid
signature.detail: A stunning bookstore set inside a former theater, often ranked among the world's most beautiful. Entry is free; visit on a weekday to browse in peace.

signature.name: Puente de la Mujer
signature.detail: A sleek white pedestrian bridge by Santiago Calatrava in the modern Puerto Madero district. Walk across at sunset and continue along the waterfront for dinner.

signature.name: MALBA
signature.detail: The leading museum of Latin American art, with strong holdings of modern and contemporary work. Closed on Tuesdays; check for discounted late-afternoon tickets.

signature.name: Palacio Barolo
signature.detail: A striking 1920s tower inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. Book a guided tour to reach the lighthouse at the top for skyline views.

food: Casual meal $10-18; steak dinner with wine $25-40
transport: Subte about $1 a ride; taxis and rideshares moderate
